headline: Recommended updated job description for Rachel Clemenzi in Special Education, reporting to Michael Jarvis.
summary: The meeting covered updated job descriptions for three non-union contracts, but only one was reviewed. The updated job description for Rachel Clemenzi, who has been acting as out-of-district coordinator for the past year, was recommended for approval.
decisions: Recommended approval of the updated job description for Rachel Clemenzi, Special Education, by a 3-0 roll call vote.

decision_evidence.quote: Upon a motion by Ms. Clancy, seconded by Ms. Dagle, it was unanimously VOTED: By Roll Call Vote: Kathleen Clancy - Yes Heather Dagle - Yes William Melvin - Yes To recommend approval of the updated job description to the full School Committee as presented.

THE GLOUCESTER PUBLIC SCHOOLS 
Our mission is for all students to be successful, engaged, lifelong learners. 
Online Personnel Subcommittee Meeting Minutes 
Thursday, October 8, 2026 
11:30 A.m. 
Members Present  Administration Present 
William Melvin, Chairperson  Amy Pasquarello, Superintendent 
Kathleen Clancy, Vice Chairperson 
Heather Dagle   
This meeting was conducted with the Personnel Subcommittee online 
and the public participating remotely via Zoom. 
I. CALL TO ORDER – Chairperson William Melvin called the meeting to order at 11:30 am.
Effective August 16, 2023, the public is welcome to attend in person.  Alternatively, the
public may attend through the zoom link provided on the agenda.  The meeting notice
will reflect if the meeting is Zoom only.  As the recent amendments to the Open Meeting
Law allows, the Subcommittee may continue to hold meetings remotely.  Please note the
in-person meeting will not be suspended or terminated if technological problems interrupt
the remote connection.
See below link to meeting recording:
